result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred position by eliminating Customer-payable liquidated damages and penalties. However, it goes beyond what is necessary by extending the delinquency period from 10 to 30 days and adding “proper, undisputed” invoice qualifications. More seriously, stating that interest is Vendor’s “sole remedy” could inadvertently eliminate Vendor’s right to recover the unpaid principal or exercise other contractual remedies. The clause should instead state that interest is the sole additional monetary charge for late payment, without disturbing collection rights or unrelated remedies.
